subject: general
question: Which of the following is an example of a natural pesticide?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rotenone**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rotenone** is an example of a **natural pesticide.**
 
• **Rotenone **is used as a **pesticide, insecticide**, and as** nonselective piscicide.**
 
• It is a naturally occurring complex ketone, derived from the roots of the Lonchocarpus species.
 
• It is a commonly used pesticide and is also used in lakes and reservoirs to kill fish that are perceived as pests.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane (DDT) **is an insecticide used in agriculture. The United States banned the use of DDT in 1972. Some countries outside the United States still use DDT to control of mosquitoes that spread malaria.
 
• **Heptachlor -** It** **is used primarily against **soil insects** and **termites. **It is also used against **some crop pests** and to **combat malaria.**
 
• **Chlordane or chlordan, **is an **organochlorine compound **used as a **pesticide.** It was first used to **eradicate the termites.**
